_doc: Every word the app shows, in one place. Change any line on the right of a colon and it changes in the app; keep the names on the left as they are. Words in {braces} are filled in by the app (a name, a number, a time), so keep them, but you can move them around the line. A pair of lines with "one" and "other" is for one thing and for many ("1 day", "3 days"). Small headings over lists (like "Your collection") are shown in capitals automatically, so write them normally. To add home screen greetings or walk quotes, add a line to their lists. Names of animals, gifts, places, clothes, grades and achievements live with the rest of their details in the other files in this folder.

greetings._doc: The line above the focus orb on the home screen. One is picked each time you come home: half the time a greeting for the time of day (morning 5am to noon, afternoon to 5pm, evening to 10pm, then night), otherwise a line from 'anytime'. '{name}' becomes the player's name; lines with it are skipped until they've set one. 'fallback' shows if a list is ever empty.

weather_prompt.title: Bring your weather along?
weather_prompt.body: Your walks can follow the real sunrise, sunset and weather where you are. Your rough location comes from your internet connection and is only used to look those up. You can change this in settings.

focus.hint_first_pet: Tap to adopt your first pet

choose_focus.no_pets_body: Tap the + to adopt one for something you're working on.
choose_focus.tap_to_walk: Tap your pet to start walking
choose_focus.delete_body: {pet} will go for good. Time you've already spent stays in your stats.
choose_focus.complete_body: It moves to Completed with everything {pet} found along the way. You can't undo this.

walk.end_body: {pet} hasn't found a gift yet. {time} more and it will.

finish.title: Focus complete
finish.too_short: Walks under a minute aren't saved.
finish.no_gift_why: Focus for {minutes} minutes or more and your pet finds you one.

ended.title: Focus ended
ended.why: You closed the app, so your walk with {pet} stopped.
ended.too_short: It was too short to count, and there's no gift this time.
ended.counted: Your {time} still counts, but there's no gift this time.

gifts.title: Gifts
gifts.empty_body: Focus for {minutes} minutes and your pet dives into the bushes to find you one.

gift.wearable: Wearable ({slot}). Dress your character on your profile, above the focus screen.
gift.trade_short: Trade in {cost} for {a_rarity} gift: {left} more to go.
gift.no_trade: Legendary gifts can't be traded in.

completed.title: Completed
completed.empty_body: When a project's done, tap the green tick on the choose focus screen and it moves here, with everything your pet found along the way.

shelf.heading: Gift shelf
shelf.title: Your shelf
shelf.how_mouse: Drag gifts onto the shelf, along it and off it.
shelf.how_touch: Hold a gift to pick it up, then drag it onto the shelf, along it or off it.

rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.to_next: {xp} XP to level {level}. You get 1 XP for each minute focused, and more for gifts.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sound_note: Taps, pops, barks and the bong.
settings.ambience_note: Water, birdsong and wind while you walk.
settings.reduce_motion_note: Gentler scenery and quicker, simpler animations.
settings.keep_screen_on_note: Stops your phone or laptop sleeping during a walk.
settings.weather_note: Walks follow the real sky where you are, from your rough location (worked out from your internet connection).
